methods.description: Place the centre on the vertex and zero on one arm, then follow the other arm to read degrees.
Select the paired scale whose zero lies on the starting arm.
Measure the smaller angle and subtract it from a full turn of360degrees.
Check a paired reading against acute/obtuse benchmark sizes.
Explain and correct a centre or baseline alignment error.
Record the measurement with the degree symbol and explain degrees.
Measure both turns consistently and compare their sizes.
